summary: Kairos Pharma, Ltd. filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing it won the 2026 Biotech Breakthrough Awards' Cancer Immunology Solution of the Year category for ENV-105 (carotuximab), an investigational antibody targeting therapy resistance in metastatic prostate cancer and non-small cell lung cancer. No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed; the item is a routine product/clinical recognition furnished under Items 8.01 and 9.01 and expressly not deemed filed for Section 18 purposes. No deal terms; watch only for subsequent clinical or financing disclosures.
